Press a keyboard key (Enter) and verify success

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.interact_async(engine, url, [{:click, %{selector: "\#searchbox"}}, {:type_text, %{selector: "\#searchbox", text: "test"}}, {:press, %{key: "Enter"}}])
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 2).success)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 2).action_type)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 2).action_index)
```
